# Brand DESIGN.md Index

74 brand design-language files. Each is a Stitch-format DESIGN.md:
YAML frontmatter with measured color/typography tokens, then prose rules.
Use them to calibrate a design *direction* ("Linear-clean", "Apple-y"),
never to clone a real brand's identity onto a client site.

Read one with: `agent-data/design-md/<brand>/DESIGN.md`
